questions.question: The symbol which is used to separate the user name and email server parts of an email is:
questions.questionHtml: The symbol which is used to separate the user name and email server parts of an email is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is @.

Key Points

  • The "@" symbol is used to separate the user name from the email server in an email address.
  • It is a standard convention in email addresses, ensuring correct routing of the message to the intended recipient.
  • The "@" symbol was first chosen by Ray Tomlinson in 1971 as a way to distinguish between the user's name and their machine (server) name.
  • This symbol is universally recognized and used in all email systems across the globe.

Additional Information

  • Email Address Structure:
    • An email address typically has the format: username@domain.com
    • Username: Identifies the email account holder.
    • Domain: Specifies the mail server responsible for receiving and delivering the email. The domain usually follows the format: domain.extension (e.g., gmail.com, yahoo.com).
  • Importance of the "@" Symbol:
    • The "@" symbol separates the user's name from the domain name, making it possible to route the email to the correct server and user.
    • It ensures the uniqueness of each email address, avoiding conflicts in email delivery.
  • History and Origin:
    • The "@" symbol has been used since the 16th century in commerce and accounting as a shorthand for "at the rate of."
    • Ray Tomlinson, a computer engineer, selected the "@" symbol to denote the separation of the user and their host computer in email addresses in 1971.
  • Other Symbols in Email Addresses:
    • While the "@" symbol is mandatory, other symbols like periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_) can be used in the username portion.
    • However, these symbols cannot be used consecutively or start/end the username.

questions.question: Which of the following fields tells the recipient what the message is about?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following fields tells the recipient what the message is about?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Subject.

Key Points

  • The Subject field in an email message is a brief description of the content of the message.
  • It helps the recipient to understand the purpose or main idea of the message before opening it.
  • A clear and concise subject line can increase the chances of the email being read and acted upon.
  • It is a standard field in email messages, often displayed prominently in the recipient's inbox.

Additional Information

  • Date
    • This field indicates the date and time when the email was sent.
    • It helps the recipient know when the email was composed and dispatched.
  • To
    • This field contains the email address of the main recipient(s) of the message.
    • It is a mandatory field in an email, without which the email cannot be sent.
  • Signature
    • This is a block of text automatically appended at the end of an email message.
    • It often contains the sender's name, contact information, and other relevant details.
    • Signatures help in providing consistent contact information and can also be used for branding purposes.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of an email message?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is NOT a component of an email message?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Ncc.

Key Points

  • An email message typically consists of several components, including:
    • To: The primary recipient(s) of the email.
    • Cc: Stands for "Carbon Copy," and is used to send a copy of the email to additional recipients.
    • Subject: A brief summary of the email's content.
    • Body: The main content of the email.
  • However, Ncc is not a standard component of an email message.
  • In contrast, Bcc (Blind Carbon Copy) is another common component that is used to send a copy of the email to recipients without disclosing their email addresses to others.

Additional Information

  • The To, Cc, and Bcc fields are used to specify the recipients of the email in different ways.
  • The Subject line helps recipients understand the purpose of the email at a glance.
  • The email's body can contain text, images, links, and other multimedia content.
  • Understanding these components is essential for effective email communication.

questions.question: Which option allows you to increase the size of selected text in Microsoft Word 365?
questions.questionHtml: Which option allows you to increase the size of selected text in Microsoft Word 365?

The correct answer is Font Size.

Key Points

  • Printing a document in Microsoft Word 365 involves accessing the Print command from the File menu.
  • After selecting the Print command, you must then select the printer and other print settings before confirming the action by selecting 'Ok' or 'Print'.
  • This process ensures that the document is sent to the selected printer for printing.
  • Using the Print command allows users to specify settings such as the number of copies, page range, and orientation.

 Additional Information

  • Underline:
    • This feature adds a line beneath the selected text.
    • It's commonly used to emphasize words or phrases, such as hyperlinks or titles.
    • You can apply a simple underline, a double underline, or even change the color of the underline for visual distinction.
    • In Word 365, you can easily underline text by selecting it and clicking the "U" button on the Home tab, or using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+U.
  • Font Size:
    • This determines the size of the characters in your document.
    • It's measured in points (pt).
    • Increasing the font size makes the text larger and more prominent, while decreasing it makes it smaller and more subtle.
    • You can adjust the font size using the drop-down menu in the Font group on the Home tab or by entering a specific size value directly.
  • Bold:
    • This makes the selected text appear thicker and darker.
    • It's a common way to emphasize important words, phrases, or headings.
    • In Word 365, you can make text bold by selecting it and clicking the "B" button on the Home tab, or using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+B.
  • Italic:
    • This slants the selected text to the right.
    • It's often used for emphasizing words, indicating foreign words or phrases, or highlighting titles of books, movies, or songs.
    • In Word 365, you can make text italic by selecting it and clicking the "I" button on the Home tab, or using the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+I.

questions.question: What information is typically required to sign in to an email client?
questions.questionHtml: What information is typically required to sign in to an email client?

options.text: Full name and date of birth
options.html: Full name and date of birth

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Email address and password.

Key Points

  • To sign in to an email client, users are typically required to provide their email address and password.
  • The email address serves as a unique identifier for the user’s account.
  • The password ensures that only authorized users can access the account, enhancing security.
  • Many email clients also offer additional security measures, such as two-factor authentication, for extra protection.

Additional Information

  • Email Address:
    • An email address is a unique identifier that allows users to send and receive electronic messages.
    • It typically consists of a username, the "@" symbol, and a domain name (e.g., user@example.com).
    • Email addresses are required to create an account on an email client or service.
  • Password:
    • A password is a secret word or string of characters used for user authentication to prove identity or gain access to resources.
    • Passwords should be kept confidential and complex (a mix of letters, numbers, and special characters) to ensure the security of the account.
    • Regularly updating the password and not sharing it with others is recommended for enhanced security.
  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA):
    • 2FA is an additional security layer used to ensure that people trying to gain access to an online account are who they say they are.
    • First, a user will enter their username and a password. Then, instead of immediately gaining access, they will be required to provide another piece of information.
    • This second factor could come from one of the following categories: something you know (password), something you have (smartphone), or something you are (fingerprint).
  • Email Client:
    • An email client is a software application used to access and manage a user’s email.Email clients can be web-based (like Gmail) or desktop applications (like Microsoft Outlook).
    • Email clients provide users with functionalities such as sending, receiving, organizing, and storing email messages.

  • Shortcuts that are commonly used in MS Word for formatting text:

    • Ctrl+U: Underlines the selected text. It adds a horizontal line beneath the selected text.
    • Ctrl+Shift+F: Applies the "Font" dialog box. It allows you to modify the font style, size, color, and other formatting options for the selected text.

    • Ctrl+Shift+<: Decreases the font size of the selected text.
    • Ctrl+Shift+>: Increases the font size of the selected text.
    • Ctrl+E: Centers the selected text. It aligns the text horizontally in the center of the page or text box.
    • Ctrl+L: Left-aligns the selected text. It aligns the text horizontally to the left margin.
    • Ctrl+R: Right-aligns the selected text. It aligns the text horizontally to the right margin.
    • Ctrl+J: Justifies the selected text. It aligns the text both horizontally to the left and right margins, creating even spacing between words.

questions.questionHtml: Which of the following keyboard shortcut is used to insert a hyperlink in an MS Word 2007 document?
questions.solution:
• To insert the hyperlink in MS Word 2007 document we can use Ctrl + K shortcut.
  • Alt+K is a keyboard shortcut most often used to open the Transitions tab in the Ribbon.

questions.question: Which of the following refers to the specific address associated with each web page displayed on the internet?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following refers to the specific address associated with each web page displayed on the internet?
questions.solution: URL represents the name or address of a website from which it is known, identified, and used on the Internet. It is also called Uniform Resource Locator. URL can be divided into three parts: Protocol Designation, Host Name or Address, and File or Resource Location.

questions.question: What is the full form of TCP/IP, with reference to internet protocols?
questions.questionHtml: What is the full form of TCP/IP, with reference to internet protocols?

options.text: Transfer Control Protocol and Internet Protocol
options.html: Transfer Control Protocol and Internet Protocol

options.text: Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol
options.html: Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol

options.text: Transmission Control Protocol and International Protocol
options.html: Transmission Control Protocol and International Protocol

questions.solution:
• TCP/IP stands for Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol.
  • The Internet protocol suite is the conceptual model and set of communications protocols used in the Internet and similar computer networks.
  • It is commonly known as TCP/IP because the foundational protocols in the suite are the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and the Internet Protocol (IP).
